<style>

:root{--bg:#120b22;--bg2:#1a0f33;--card:#20143d;--line:rgba(212,175,106,.28);--gold:#d9b46c;--gold2:#f0d594;--cream:#f8f3ea;--ink:#1d1630;--mut:#b9afd0;--violet:#7a4fd0}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}html,body{overflow-x:hidden}
body{font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:#fff;line-height:1.55;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
h1,h2,h3{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-weight:600;line-height:1.08}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:15px 30px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;cursor:pointer;border:1px solid transparent;transition:.2s}
.btn.gold{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#2a1c05;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(217,180,108,.28)}
.btn.gold:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(217,180,108,.4)}
.btn.ghost{border-color:var(--gold);color:#fff;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.btn.ghost:hover{background:rgba(217,180,108,.12)}
.eyebrow{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--gold);font-weight:600}
/* nav */
nav{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(18,11,34,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
nav .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;height:74px;gap:20px}
.logo{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.logo svg{width:34px;height:34px}
.logo b{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.05em;font-weight:600;display:block;line-height:1}
.logo small{font-size:8.5px;letter-spacing:.2em;color:var(--mut);text-transform:uppercase}
nav ul{display:flex;gap:26px;list-style:none;font-size:14px;color:#e8e0f6}
nav ul a:hover{color:var(--gold)}
nav .btn{padding:11px 22px;font-size:14px}
/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(1000px 600px at 78% 10%,#4a2a86 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(700px 500px at 5% 90%,#2b1654 0%,transparent 60%),var(--bg)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:20px;align-items:center;min-height:640px;padding-top:50px;padding-bottom:60px}
.pill{display:inline-block;border:1px solid var(--gold);color:var(--gold2);border-radius:999px;padding:6px 16px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:26px}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(46px,6.4vw,84px);letter-spacing:-.01em}
.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold)}
.hero h2{font-size:clamp(26px,3vw,38px);font-weight:500;margin:18px 0 18px}
.hero p.lead{color:#d9d0ee;max-width:520px;font-size:16px}
.mini{display:flex;gap:30px;margin:34px 0;flex-wrap:wrap}
.mini div{text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;color:#d9d0ee;min-width:78px}
.mini svg{width:34px;height:34px;stroke:var(--gold);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;display:block;margin:0 auto 8px}
.cta-row{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stores{display:flex;gap:12px;margin-top:26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.store{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.25);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 16px;background:#000;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.1}
.store small{display:block;font-size:9px;font-weight:400;color:#bbb}
.store.soon{opacity:.85}
.heroimg{position:relative;height:560px}
.heroimg .photo{position:absolute;inset:0 90px 0 -40px;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center top/cover no-repeat;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 38%,#000 80%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,#000 70%,transparent 100%);-webkit-mask-composite:source-in;mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0,#000 38%,#000 80%,transparent 100%),linear-gradient(180deg,#000 70%,transparent 100%);mask-composite:intersect}
/* phone */
.phone{color:#fff;width:210px;border-radius:30px;background:#0e0820;border:3px solid #3b2a62;padding:14px 12px 12px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(217,180,108,.25);position:relative}
.phone .notch{width:60px;height:5px;border-radius:9px;background:#2b2147;margin:0 auto 12px}
.phone h4{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:17px;text-align:center;font-weight:600}
.phone p{font-size:10px;color:var(--mut);text-align:center;margin:4px 0 12px}
.phone .it{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:10px;padding:8px 9px;font-size:10px;margin-bottom:7px}
.phone .it i{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#8b5cf6,#5b34b8);flex:none}
.phone .lotus{width:36px;height:36px;margin:0 auto 6px;display:block}
.heroimg .phone{position:absolute;right:-6px;top:30px;transform:rotate(6deg)}
/* evolution */
.evo{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:90px 0}
.evo .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:40px;align-items:center}
.evo h2{font-size:clamp(34px,4vw,54px);margin:14px 0 18px}
.evo h2 em{color:#6a3fc4;font-style:italic}
.evo p{color:#5a5170;max-width:440px}
.stats{display:flex;gap:0;margin-top:34px}
.stats div{padding:0 22px;border-left:1px solid #d9d0c2}.stats div:first-child{padding-left:0;border:0}
.stats b{display:block;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:30px;color:var(--ink)}
.stats span{font-size:12px;color:#7a7190}
.phones{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:0;align-items:center}
.phones .phone{width:190px}
.phones .phone:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(-5deg) translateX(18px) scale(.94)}
.phones .phone:nth-child(2){z-index:2;width:206px}
.phones .phone:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(5deg) translateX(-18px) scale(.94)}
.book{border-radius:12px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a1c74,#150b30);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:18px 10px;text-align:center;margin:8px 0 12px}
.book b{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.14em;display:block;margin-top:6px}
.book span{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:.3em;color:var(--gold)}
.mbtn{display:block;text-align:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#2a1c05;border-radius:999px;padding:7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:600}
.bubble{background:#fff;color:#241a3d;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 10px;font-size:9.5px;margin:6px 0}
/* features */
.feat{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#150c2a,#1a0f33);padding:80px 0}
.feat h2{text-align:center;font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin-bottom:44px;font-weight:500}
.feat h2 em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.grid6{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr);gap:14px}
.fc{background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:26px 16px;text-align:center}
.fc .ic{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;margin:0 auto 14px;border:1px solid var(--line);display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(217,180,108,.06)}
.fc svg{width:26px;height:26px;stroke:var(--gold);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.fc h3{font-family:Inter,sans-serif;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px}
.fc p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--mut);line-height:1.5}
/* pricing */
.price{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:90px 0}
.price .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.8fr 1fr 1fr .5fr;gap:22px;align-items:center}
.price h2{font-size:clamp(34px,3.8vw,50px);margin:12px 0 16px}
.price .intro p{color:#5a5170;font-size:15px}
.sig{font-family:'Great Vibes',cursive;color:var(--gold);font-size:30px;line-height:1.1;margin-top:34px;filter:brightness(.82)}
.plan{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6dcc9;border-radius:20px;padding:30px 24px;box-shadow:0 14px 40px rgba(60,40,100,.08)}
.plan.pop{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#26144a,#150b30);color:#fff;border:2px solid var(--gold);position:relative;padding-top:38px;transform:scale(1.03)}
.plan .tag{position:absolute;top:-1px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--gold2),var(--gold));color:#2a1c05;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;font-weight:700;padding:5px 18px;border-radius:0 0 10px 10px}
.plan h3{font-size:24px;text-align:center}
.plan .sub{text-align:center;font-size:12.5px;color:#8a809f;margin:4px 0 14px}
.plan.pop .sub{color:var(--mut)}
.plan .amt{text-align:center;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:56px;font-weight:600}
.plan.pop .amt{color:#c8a7ff}
.plan .amt small{font-family:Inter;font-size:11px;font-weight:400;color:#8a809f;margin-left:6px}
.plan ul{list-style:none;margin:18px 0 24px}
.plan li{font-size:13.5px;padding:5px 0 5px 26px;position:relative}
.plan li:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:2px;top:10px;width:12px;height:7px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.plan .btn{width:100%;justify-content:center}
.trust{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6dcc9;border-radius:16px;padding:12px 18px}
.trust div{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eee5d6;font-size:12px;color:#5a5170}.trust div:last-child{border:0}
.trust b{display:block;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px}
/* faq */
.faq{background:#150c2a;padding:80px 0}
.faq h2{text-align:center;font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,44px);margin-bottom:34px}
.faq details{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 22px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.03)}
.faq summary{cursor:pointer;font-weight:600;font-size:15px}
.faq details p{color:var(--mut);font-size:14px;margin-top:10px}
/* final */
.final{position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:90px 0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#120b22 40%,rgba(18,11,34,.15)),url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) 100% 50%/auto 100% no-repeat,#120b22}
.final .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.final h2{font-size:clamp(36px,4.6vw,60px)}.final h2 em{color:var(--gold);font-style:normal}
.final p{color:#d9d0ee;margin-top:12px;max-width:420px}
.final .side{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.badges{display:flex;gap:34px;font-size:12px;color:#d9d0ee}.badges div{text-align:center}
.badges svg{width:26px;height:26px;stroke:var(--gold);fill:none;stroke-width:1.5;display:block;margin:0 auto 6px}
footer{background:#0b0616;padding:34px 0;text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:#8f84a8}
footer p{max-width:760px;margin:6px auto 0}
@media(max-width:960px){
 nav ul{display:none}
 .hero .wrap,.evo .wrap,.price .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}
 .heroimg{height:460px}.heroimg .photo{inset:0}
 .heroimg .phone{right:0;width:170px}
 .grid6{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
 .plan.pop{transform:none}
 .phones .phone{width:112px!important;padding:10px 7px}.phones .phone h4{font-size:12px}.phones .phone .it{font-size:8px;padding:5px}.mini{gap:16px}.stats div{padding:0 12px}.badges{gap:18px}
 .final{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(18,11,34,.85),rgba(18,11,34,.7)),url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/cover}
}

/* ebook */
.ebook{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1a0f33,#120b22);padding:90px 0}
.ebook .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;gap:50px;align-items:center}
.bk{perspective:1400px;display:flex;justify-content:center}
.bk .cover{width:270px;aspect-ratio:2/3;border-radius:4px 10px 10px 4px;background:url(data:image/jpeg;base64,) center/cover;transform:rotateY(-22deg) rotateX(3deg);box-shadow:-16px 22px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.65),0 0 60px rgba(122,79,208,.35);position:relative}
.bk .cover:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:12px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.45),rgba(255,255,255,.12),transparent)}
.ebook h2{font-size:clamp(32px,3.8vw,48px);margin:12px 0 16px}.ebook h2 em{color:var(--gold);font-style:italic}
.ebook p{color:#d9d0ee;max-width:480px}
.ebook ul{list-style:none;margin:22px 0 28px}
.ebook li{padding:7px 0 7px 28px;position:relative;color:#ece6f7;font-size:15px}
.ebook li:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;top:13px;width:12px;height:7px;border-left:2px solid var(--gold);border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold);transform:rotate(-45deg)}
/* testimonials */
.testi{background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);padding:80px 0}
.testi h2{text-align:center;font-size:clamp(30px,3.6vw,46px);margin-bottom:36px}
.tg{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.tc{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e6dcc9;border-radius:18px;padding:26px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(60,40,100,.07)}
.tc p{font-size:15px;color:#3b3252;font-style:italic}
.tc footer{background:none;padding:16px 0 0;text-align:left;color:var(--ink);font-size:13px}
.tc footer b{display:block}.tc footer span{color:#8a809f}
.stars{color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:3px;margin-bottom:10px}
@media(max-width:960px){.ebook .wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tg{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ebook p{max-width:none}}

</style>
